catalog.ask.body1: {ask_name} works like an experienced colleague who can read your farm records. Try a question such as:
catalog.ask.body_with_data: Answers draw on the records you have connected and show what they are based on.
catalog.ask.body_without_data: Until you connect field records, answers rely on general agronomic knowledge, and AGRO-AI tells you when it needs your data to be specific.
catalog.ask.example1: Which fields should we prioritize for irrigation this week?
catalog.ask.example2: What changed in our water use compared with last month?
catalog.ask.example3: What evidence do we still need for our next compliance report?
catalog.ask.headline: Ask the questions you deal with every day
catalog.ask.preview: Start with a question you would ask an agronomist or irrigation manager.
catalog.ask.subject: Questions about your farm business, answered with {ask_name}
catalog.common.button_fallback: If the button does not work, copy this link into your browser:
catalog.common.reason: You are receiving this email because you created an AGRO-AI account for {organization}.
catalog.common.unsubscribe_note: Account, security, and billing emails are not affected.
catalog.connect_data.body1: AGRO-AI does not ask you to replace your controllers, sensors, or spreadsheets. It reads from them. Upload an irrigation log, a controller export, or a field record, or connect a supported system.
catalog.connect_data.body2: Once your data is in, recommendations, readiness checks, and reports are based on your farm business rather than general guidance.
catalog.connect_data.headline: Work with the information you already have
catalog.connect_data.preview: Use the systems and files you already have. Nothing needs to be replaced.
catalog.connect_data.subject: Bring your field records into AGRO-AI
catalog.connectors.body1: Most farm businesses already use several systems: irrigation controllers, weather data, field records, and shared documents. AGRO-AI connects to them so the information is in one place.
catalog.connectors.body_free: On the {plan_free} plan you can import files directly. Live connections are included from the {plan_professional} plan.
catalog.connectors.body_paid: Your plan includes live connections. Each one you add makes recommendations and reports more complete.
catalog.connectors.headline: Built to work with your existing systems
catalog.connectors.preview: AGRO-AI works with the controllers and records you already have.
catalog.connectors.subject: Connect AGRO-AI to the systems you already use
catalog.field.body1: When someone in the field spots uneven emergence, a leak, or crop stress in a plot, {field_name} lets them record it on the spot: a voice note, photos, a short description, and the location.
catalog.field.body2: Observations are saved even without a connection and sync when the device is back online, so your team keeps a dated record tied to the field instead of a message lost in a group chat.
catalog.field.headline: Turn field inspections into useful records
catalog.field.preview: Record observations by voice, photo, or text, even without a signal.
catalog.field.subject: Capture what you see in the field
catalog.market.body1: In AGRO-AI, crop and market intelligence come together in {market_name}. Add a commercial position for each crop and season with your expected production, inventory, and costs, then record your contracts.
catalog.market.body2: You then see how much is contracted, your projected margin, and how much revenue is exposed. The scenario lab shows how changes in price, yield, or costs would affect the result. It supports commercial decisions; AGRO-AI does not execute trades.
catalog.market.headline: Crop and market intelligence in one workspace
catalog.market.preview: Add a commercial position for a crop and see what is contracted, your projected margin, and where you are exposed.
catalog.market.subject: Your crops and markets in {market_name}
catalog.plans.body1: The {plan_free} plan is meant for trying AGRO-AI in a single workspace. When your farm business relies on it every day, the {plan_professional} plan adds:
catalog.plans.body2: The {plan_team} and {plan_network} plans add team invitations, shared workspaces, and reporting across several sites for larger farm businesses.
catalog.plans.headline: What changes when you move beyond {plan_free}
catalog.plans.item_ask: {ask_name}: {pro_messages} questions a month, answered using your records
catalog.plans.item_uploads: Up to {pro_uploads} evidence files a month (instead of {free_uploads})
catalog.plans.preview: What changes on the {plan_professional} plan, in plain numbers.
catalog.plans.subject: Is the {plan_free} plan still enough for your farm business?
catalog.plans.usage_note: This month {organization} has uploaded {used} of the {limit} evidence files included in its plan.
catalog.reactivation.body1: You set up AGRO-AI for {organization} but have not been back recently. The most useful next step is:
catalog.reactivation.headline: Your next step in AGRO-AI
catalog.reactivation.next_ask: Ask your first question about your fields, water, or reporting.
catalog.reactivation.next_connect_data: Connect or upload your field records so answers are based on your farm business.
catalog.reactivation.next_market: Add your first commercial position in {market_name}.
catalog.reactivation.preview: One step would make AGRO-AI more useful for {organization}.
catalog.reactivation.subject: Pick up where you left off in AGRO-AI
catalog.team.body1: Your plan includes {seats} users. Invite the people who make or carry out field decisions, such as irrigation managers, agronomists, and farm managers, and give each person the role they need.
catalog.team.headline: Work from the same records as your team
catalog.team.preview: Field staff, agronomists, and managers can work from the same records.
catalog.team.subject: Bring your team into AGRO-AI
catalog.unsubscribe.body: AGRO-AI will no longer send welcome emails to this address. Account, security, and billing emails will still be sent.
catalog.unsubscribe.invalid: This link is invalid or has expired.
catalog.unsubscribe.title: You are unsubscribed from welcome emails
catalog.welcome.body1: Your account for {organization} is ready. AGRO-AI is most useful once it understands your farm business: your fields and plots, the crops you manage, and the records you already keep.
catalog.welcome.body2: Start by reviewing your workspace and adding what you know about your farm business. It takes a few minutes and makes every answer more specific to your fields.
catalog.welcome.headline: Welcome to AGRO-AI
catalog.welcome.preview: Set up your farm business so AGRO-AI can work with your fields, water, and records.
catalog.welcome.subject: Welcome to AGRO-AI
